import unittest
from conftest import trace


def fail_cleanup(label):
    trace(label)
    raise ValueError(label)


class QueuedErrors(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.addCleanup(fail_cleanup, "first-registered-cleanup-error")
        self.addCleanup(fail_cleanup, "last-registered-cleanup-error")

    def test_passes_before_errors(self):
        trace("body-passed-before-errors")

    def tearDown(self):
        trace("tearDown-error")
        raise RuntimeError("tearDown-error")
